name: Brickell
family_profile: Couples without young kids, active urban life
highlights: Walking distance to Mary Brickell Village
identity: Brickell is Miami's tropical Manhattan — glass towers, private banks, executives, and US$ 200 dinners across the Miami River. Snowbirds from NY, NJ, and Boston who love city density find the same kinetic energy they left behind — but with 60% lower property tax and zero state income tax. Walkable, vertical, and zero school-zone politics.
landmark: Mary Brickell Village · Brickell City Centre

dining.name: Zuma Miami
dining.note: Robata grill with Miami River view — the lunch and after-work hotspot for the Brickell financial crowd.

dining.name: Amazónico Miami
dining.note: Three floors inspired by the rainforest, dinner becomes ambient theater. Reservations 2 weeks out.

dining.name: Casa Tua Cucina
dining.note: Open kitchen at Brickell City Centre, fresh pasta and refined wine list.

groceries.name: Publix at Mary Brickell Village
groceries.note: Walking distance from most buildings — open 7 days, large selection.

groceries.name: Whole Foods Market Downtown
groceries.note: 299 SE 3rd Street, minutes by car or Metromover.

groceries.name: Trader Joe's Brickell
groceries.note: New store on SW 8th Street, more accessible option for daily essentials.

schools.name: Southside Preparatory Academy
schools.rank: A-rated · serves most of Brickell, walking distance.

schools.name: Riverside Elementary
schools.rank: A-rated · public option close to the neighborhood.

schools.name: Downtown Doral Charter Upper School
schools.rank: Top-rated · alternative for families seeking high-performing charter.

lifestyle_moments: Bank meeting at 9am, lunch at Zuma at noon — same elevator
Rooftop happy hour with the skyline lighting up across the bay
Sunrise run on Brickell Key with yachts anchored as backdrop
Friday at 5pm: Mary Brickell Village happy hour without moving the car
Sunday morning at Casa Tua Cucina, brunch with bay view

name: Aventura
investor_profile: Family seeking USD rental + established international community base
family_profile: Families with kids · public schools in the Top 100 USA
highlights: Aventura Waterways K-8 in Top USA ranking
Mall, schools, hospital within walking distance
identity: Aventura is where wealthy Latin-American families settled — you find Brazilian bakeries, Spanish-speaking pediatricians, and Portuguese-speaking accountants alongside top Florida public schools. Northeast retirees with grown kids who want grandkids visiting in a familiar bilingual environment love it. Vertical gated buildings, full security, walking distance to mall, hospital and schools.
landmark: Aventura Mall · Aventura Circle (2.4 mile walking path)

dining.name: Fogo de Chão Aventura
dining.note: The community meeting point — you feel Brazil entering the door.

dining.name: Boteco do Manolo
dining.note: Authentic boteco — Saturday feijoada, soccer on the TV.

dining.name: The Grill on the Alley
dining.note: Inside Aventura Mall — classic American fine dining for the post-shopping crowd.

groceries.name: Whole Foods Market Aventura
groceries.note: Open late, huge parking, walking distance from most condos.

groceries.name: Publix at Aventura
groceries.note: Multiple locations in the area — the routine staple.

groceries.name: The Fresh Market Aventura
groceries.note: For specialty cuts, cheeses and imported wines.

schools.name: Aventura City of Excellence School (ACES)
schools.rank: A+ rated · highly competitive and free for Aventura residents.

schools.name: Don Soffer Aventura High School
schools.rank: A+ rated · continues the ACES track.

schools.name: Krop Senior High School
schools.rank: Recognized magnet program · serves much of Aventura.

lifestyle_moments: Grandkid bikes to ACES — you open the gate and watch from afar, in peace
Saturday morning: bakery, then Aventura Mall without touching the car
Walking 2.4 miles around Aventura Circle at sunset with neighbors in three languages
Saturday lunch with the family at the mall food hall, kids in the play area
Sunday at Aventura Beach Club pool, the family already settled

name: Sunny Isles Beach
investor_profile: Premium investor · high-net-worth family · short-term rental
family_profile: Families with beachfront life · established international elite community
highlights: Trump Towers, Porsche Design, Estates at Acqualina
8-minute walk to Atlantic Ocean from most buildings
identity: Sunny Isles is the beachfront tier of Miami — where the balcony opens onto the Atlantic, the elevator descends straight to the sand, and weekends feel like Monaco. Northeast retirees who want pure beachfront without the urban density find their match. Vertical living, full concierge, valet at every level, ocean view as default.

dining.name: Il Mulino New York
dining.note: At the Acqualina Resort — classic five-star Italian.

dining.name: Carpaccio at Bal Harbour Shops
dining.note: The most-Instagrammed lunch in the world — celebrities, regulars, beachfront crowd.

dining.name: Makoto Bal Harbour
dining.note: Premium sushi and robata from Chef Makoto — Bal Harbour ladies-who-lunch hotspot.

groceries.name: Publix at Sunny Isles
groceries.note: On Collins Avenue, walking distance to beachfront buildings.

groceries.name: Whole Foods Market Bay Harbor
groceries.note: Few minutes — balcony view to anchored yachts.

groceries.name: Epicure Gourmet Market Sunny Isles
groceries.note: Fresh bread, European cheeses, wines — the Sunny Isles gourmet.

schools.name: Norman S. Edelcup / Sunny Isles Beach K-8
schools.rank: #47 in Florida per Niche · Top 20% of the state, free.

schools.name: Alonzo and Tracy Mourning Senior High
schools.rank: Regional high school, serves Sunny Isles.

schools.name: Ruth K. Broad Bay Harbor K-8
schools.rank: A-rated · nearby option in Bay Harbor Islands.

lifestyle_moments: 8-minute morning walk to the ocean — doorman holds your towel
Lunch at Bal Harbour Shops without a driver, returning with Hermès bag
Direct elevator from parking to your unit at Porsche Design Tower
Beach club Saturday: ocean breeze, classic 4-piece band, watching the sunset over the Atlantic
Evening walk on Collins Avenue, neighborhood already familiar

name: Orlando
investor_profile: Family vacation home + seasonal short-term tourist rental
family_profile: Families with young kids · Disney lovers · regular vacations
highlights: Single-family homes with pool + garage in gated community
Vacation rental laws favorable to short-term
identity: Orlando — specifically Dr. Phillips — is where the investing Northeast family buys: vacation rental yield that covers HOA + property tax + extras while the family is in NY/NJ. Single-family with pool and garage in gated community, where you spend the holidays as a family and Airbnb the rest of the year.
landmark: Restaurant Row (Sand Lake Road) · Disney Springs

dining.name: Norman's at the Ritz-Carlton Orlando
dining.note: AAA Five Diamond, by chef Norman Van Aken — destination dining.

dining.name: Big Fin Seafood Kitchen
dining.note: On Restaurant Row, big-family vibe — for post-park lunches.

dining.name: Christner's Prime Steak & Lobster
dining.note: Orlando steakhouse for decades — where locals celebrate anniversaries.

groceries.name: Publix at The Marketplace at Dr. Phillips
groceries.note: 7524 Dr. Phillips Blvd — neighborhood anchor, walking distance.

groceries.name: Whole Foods Market Sand Lake
groceries.note: At Phillips Crossing, 8003 Turkey Lake Rd.

groceries.name: Trader Joe's Dr. Phillips
groceries.note: 8323 Sand Lake Rd — only Trader Joe's in the area, well-stocked.

schools.name: Dr. Phillips High School
schools.rank: A-/A rated · recognized for performing arts and academics programs.

lifestyle_moments: 15-minute drive to enter Magic Kingdom with your kids
Vacation rental generating USD income while you're back home
Dinner on Restaurant Row choosing among 30 options on the same avenue
Sunday at Disney Springs with the family, no parking fight
Late afternoon in the pool of the gated community, kids running with neighbors

name: Tampa
tagline: The Florida city on the rise
investor_profile: Investor seeking emerging appreciation + high cap rate
family_profile: Families in transition · quality of life without Miami cost
highlights: Highest % appreciation in FL over the last 4 years
Cost of living 30% lower than Miami
identity: Tampa is Florida's rising city — property still priced 30-40% below Miami, comparable lifestyle, growing diaspora and accelerated appreciation. Northeast retirees and investors looking for the next Florida 5-year play go here.
landmark: Tampa Riverwalk · Bayshore Boulevard (4.5 miles of linear waterfront walkway)

dining.name: Bern's Steak House
dining.note: Wine list with 6,800+ labels — Tampa historic destination.

dining.name: Ulele
dining.note: Over the Riverwalk in Tampa Heights — cuisine that celebrates Florida's native ingredients.

dining.name: Oxford Exchange
dining.note: Iconic brunch in a bookstore-café setting — local meeting point.

groceries.name: Publix at Hyde Park
groceries.note: The neighborhood staple, walking distance to historic Hyde Park houses.

groceries.name: Whole Foods Market South Tampa
groceries.note: In Channelside / South Tampa — the premium routine option.

groceries.name: Sprouts Farmers Market Tampa
groceries.note: More accessible alternative for natural products.

schools.name: Plant High School
schools.rank: #36 in Florida per U.S. News · Top 10% of the state, A-rated.

schools.name: Roosevelt Elementary
schools.rank: #57 in Florida per U.S. News · Top 5% · Math and reading above average.

schools.name: Berkeley Preparatory School
schools.rank: One of Florida's most prestigious private schools.

lifestyle_moments: Morning walk on the 4.5 miles of Bayshore Boulevard — the longest linear waterfront walkway in the world
Brunch at Oxford Exchange on a fall Saturday
Historic dinner at Bern's choosing wine from the year you were born
Sunday in Hyde Park with the kids on a bike, vintage architecture around
Afternoon coffee on the Riverwalk watching sailboats pass
